look_here_first: Low gray-green Texas milkvetch with silky foliage, purple pea flowers, and inflated hairy pods.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; World Flora Online/WCVP currently recognize Astragalus lindheimeri.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.
best_field_traits: dry calcareous prairie and rocky habitat association
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with the annual Nuttallianus group, Lindheimer's milkvetch looks more perennial, gray, and silky, with puffier hairy pods.

learner_visual_status.note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
